id.title: id
id.description: id is an ordinary scalar, unaffected by this branch.

startDate.title: start_date
startDate.description:
start_date is a calendar date modelled as google.type.Date but documented
 in its original wire form. It is also protovalidate-required, so the
 parent's required list proves the reference is still *resolved* even
 though it is no longer *attached*.

status.title: status
status.description:
status is a generated enum documented with the vocabulary the source
 schema actually used.

retiredOn.title: retired_on
retiredOn.description: retired_on is optional and annotated, so the oneOf branch is exercised.

plainDate.title: plain_date
plainDate.description: plain_date carries no annotation and must keep the generated reference.

plainStatus.title: plain_status
plainStatus.description: plain_status carries no annotation and must keep the generated reference.

titledOnly.title: A titled date
titledOnly.description:
titled_only annotates something other than a type, so the reference must
 still be attached.

gnosticoverride.Record.title: Record
gnosticoverride.Record.description:
Record exercises every shape the message/enum branch of FieldToSchema can
 take, with and without an annotation.

gnosticoverride.Status.title: Status
gnosticoverride.Status.description: Status is a generated enum whose values carry a protobuf-style prefix.

year.title: year
year.description:
Year of the date. Must be from 1 to 9999, or 0 to specify a date without
 a year.

month.title: month
month.description:
Month of a year. Must be from 1 to 12, or 0 to specify a year without a
 month and day.

day.title: day
day.description:
Day of a month. Must be from 1 to 31 and valid for the year and month, or 0
 to specify a year by itself or a year and month where the day isn't
 significant.

google.type.Date.title: Date
google.type.Date.description:
Represents a whole or partial calendar date, such as a birthday. The time of
 day and time zone are either specified elsewhere or are insignificant. The
 date is relative to the Gregorian Calendar. This can represent one of the
 following:

 * A full date, with non-zero year, month, and day values
 * A month and day value, with a zero year, such as an anniversary
 * A year on its own, with zero month and day values
 * A year and month value, with a zero day, such as a credit card expiration
 date

 Related types are [google.type.TimeOfDay][google.type.TimeOfDay] and
 `google.protobuf.Timestamp`.
